Stat Blocks.raw_text:
**MOONSTONE FEATHERED DRAGON**
*Gargantuan dragon (gem), any neutral alignment*
**AC** 21 (natural armor)
**HP** 350 (20d20 + 140)
**Speed** 60 ft., fly 120 ft.
**STR** 24 (+7) | **DEX** 22 (+6) | **CON** 25 (+7) | **INT** 26 (+8) | **WIS** 25 (+7) | **CHA** 29 (+9)
**Saving Throws** Int +15, Wis +14, Cha +16
**Skills** Perception +21, Persuasion +16, Stealth +13
**Immunities** radiant
**Condition Immunities** charmed, frightened, exhaustion, unconscious
**Senses** truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 31
**Languages** all, telepathy 240 ft.
**CR** 23 (50,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +7

**TRAITS**
*Eidolic*

***Innate Spellcasting.*** The dragon’s spellcasting ability is Charisma. The dragon can cast the following spells, requiring no components:
• ***At will:*** faerie fire
• ***1/Day each:*** dream, dream walk, synaptic static
• ***2/Day each:*** calm emotions, dispel magic, invisibility, revivify

***Uncanny Radiance.*** Radiant damage from the dragon ignores resistances, and immunity to radiant damage only reduces the damage to half instead. This does not apply to damage the dragon might deal to itself.

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS** (4 uses)
TBA

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** The dragon makes one Bite and two Claw attacks.

***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. *Hit:* 17 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 18 (3d12) radiant damage.

***Claw.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 15 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, it is restrained and grappled (escape DC 20). While grappling a creature it cannot make Claw attacks except one each turn against the grappled creature.

***Tail.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed a DC 22 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

***Breath Weapon (Recharge 5-6).*** The dragon uses one of its breath weapon options (Moonlight Burst or Deep Dream Wave).
• ***Moonlight Burst.*** The dragon exhales a sphere of radiant moonlight at a point it can see within 300 feet, which explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere of pale radiant energy. All creatures within range must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 72 (11d12) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
• ***Deep Dream Wave.*** The dragon exhales a wave of dreamy mist in a 240-foot-cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 hour. The effect ends if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Change Shape.*** The dragon transforms into any creature that is Medium, Small or Tiny, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size), though if it is Tiny it cannot use its Multiattack. This transformation ends if the dragon is reduced to 0 hit points or uses a bonus action to end it.

**REACTIONS**
***Beyond the Web.*** When one or more creatures within 120 feet of the feathered dragon is targeted by the same magical effect or spell (except itself), the feathered dragon may grant them a +5 bonus on the first save they make against it.

***Dream Shield.*** When the dragon or a creature within 60 feet of it is targeted by a weapon attack, the dragon can grant them the effects of the *blur* spell until the end of the turn.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Attack.*** The dragon makes one Claw or Tail attack.
***Spellcast (Costs 2 Actions).*** The dragon casts a spell available through Innate Spellcasting.
***Compulsion Eye (Costs 3 Actions).*** The dragon looks into the heart of a creature it can see within 240 feet, who must succeed a DC 24 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature is charmed by the dragon until the start of the dragon’s next turn, and must use their reaction to move up to their movement speed and make a single weapon attack against a creature the dragon chooses, as directed by the dragon. If the creature is damaged by the dragon or forced to take an action that is directly harmful to it the effect ends early.
